Name: Plaça d'Espanya
Tips: 07:50 - Metro L5 to Diagonal then L3, or L2 from the Sagrada Família side, ~20 min. Early start forced by the 08:36 train. Coffee at the station if needed.

Name: FGC ticket desk (Tot Montserrat)
Cost Range: Tot Montserrat ~71.50 EUR/pp; Trans Montserrat ~50 EUR/pp
Tips: 08:15 - buy the combined ticket. TAKE TOT: the ~21.50 EUR upgrade buys ~26-30 EUR of things already planned (museum + all-you-can-eat buffet). Both options include the Barcelona Metro legs both ways. NO CHILD DISCOUNT - full adult price from age 5. The choir is NOT included in either ticket. Alternative: pre-buy the Tot voucher online and collect at Turisme de Barcelona, Pl. de Catalunya 17-S, daily 08:30-20:30.

Name: Monistrol de Montserrat (Cremallera)
Tips: RECOMMENDED final leg - ~15 min cog-train up the mountain face. Gentler, best with anyone wary of heights. FGC R5 from Pl. d'Espanya at 08:36 toward Manresa, ~1 hr in the valley, then this.

Name: Aeri de Montserrat
Tips: Alternative final leg - ~5 min, steep and spectacular, every 15 min. It swings - not for the vertigo-prone.

Name: Montserrat Monastery
Tips: ~10:15 arrival. The name means serrated mountain - fingers of conglomerate rock 1,000 m over the Llobregat valley, abbey wedged into a shelf halfway up. Benedictines here since 1025. Walk the esplanade rail for the valley drop. NOTE: cooler and breezier at 700 m, bring a layer.

Name: Basilica + La Moreneta (Black Madonna)
Tips: 10:30 - GO IN EARLY, the queue builds toward midday. File past (and touch the orb held by) the 12th-century Black Madonna, Catalonia's patroness, in her golden camarín above the altar. Centuries of candle smoke darkened her - hence La Moreneta, the little dark one. Drop into Plaça de Santa Maria and the Gothic cloister courtyard on the way out.

Name: Funicular de Sant Joan
Tips: 11:15 - Europe's steepest funicular, ~7 min. From the top station, panorama over the whole massif and easy trails - the 20-min loop to the Sant Joan hermitage viewpoint is the family-sized bite. The full Sant Jeroni summit hike is 2.5-3 hrs, not today. Ride down in time for the choir. NOTE: the Santa Cova funicular is OUT OF SERVICE until further notice.

Name: Escolania de Montserrat (boys' choir)
Tips: 13:00-13:15, be seated 12:40 - the nave fills to standing. Salve Regina + Virolai, sung by a choir documented since the 14th century. RESERVE AT reserves.abadiamontserrat.cat under 'Noon pray - Cant de l'Escolania' (NOT on escolania.cat) - pick Fri 28 Aug 2026, 4 seats. Their summer break is Aug 1-26 and they return Aug 27, so our Friday is their SECOND DAY BACK - re-check escolania.cat/en/when-do-we-sing the week before. They do not sing Saturdays.

Name: Monastery self-service buffet
Cost Range: Included in the Tot ticket (~18-22 EUR bought separately)
Tips: 13:30 - big terrace views, kids graze freely. Packed right after the choir - grab trays fast or hold 20 min.

Name: Museu de Montserrat
Cost Range: Included in the Tot ticket (~8 EUR separately)
Tips: 14:30, ~1 hr. A genuinely good small collection - Caravaggio's St Jerome, El Greco, Monet, Picasso, Dalí, plus Egyptian pieces the monks collected. Cool and dark, perfect siesta-hour cover.

Name: Camí de la Santa Cova
Tips: 15:45 optional - the cliff-ledge path down to the Holy Grotto chapel where the Madonna was reputedly found. ~25 min each way past the Rosary monuments, including a First Mystery of Glory sculpted with Gaudí's involvement. Exposed and sun-struck at this hour - skip if the group is flagging (the funicular that used to shortcut it is the closed one).

Name: Farmers' stalls (mató and honey)
Tips: 16:15 on the way out - the row of local stands sells mató (fresh curd cheese eaten with honey, the monastery's signature bite), figs and mountain honey. The authentic souvenir.

Name: Easy dinner near the hotel
Tips: 19:30 - back down by ~18:15 (cremallera/Aeri then R5 to Pl. d'Espanya, ~1.5 hrs door-to-door). Big day, keep it low-key. Check the posted return times when you arrive in the morning - late-afternoon trains run ~hourly.
